## Accepted partial result, attempt 1/5

Problem 10300020 / AMR-102-0020, rank 1249, Calegari Question 7.5. The unrestricted question remains unresolved; no novelty or current-openness certification is claimed.

The complete authored report and mathematical audit prove exact norm padding with fresh parameterized support and an explicit cone boundary, upper-ray spectra over fixed and variable nonempty essential laminations, the exact infimum-plus-endpoint criterion, and zero-volume/closed-hyperbolic ordinary nonattainment. Normality is topological normal-disk normality, not literal affine slicing. All applications of the original question retain its carrying-one hypothesis. The abstract endpoint chain complex and local descent example are included as authored mathematics, not manifold counterexamples.

Prior tight/unbranched/one-sided and surface cases are credited with their hypotheses intact. Li's unavailable preliminary tightening manuscript remains an attributed, unaudited premise restricted to the stated closed orientable atoroidal transversely orientable setting. It is not promoted to established general tightening. The full remaining obligation is flexible infimum equality plus endpoint preservation wherever ordinary attainment occurs.

## Exact publication boundary and review limits

Only six authored proof/audit/status and public-source-metadata files are added under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/10300020/`. All complete mathematical arguments and qualifications are retained. Programs, supplementary computation descriptions/results, certificates, fixtures, imported dataset contents, copied scholarly source bodies, private original/version identities and private coordination material are excluded. No excluded computation is rewritten as prose.

This edition is AI-assisted and unrefereed. Scoped acceptance is not external human peer review, journal acceptance or formal proof-assistant certification. Recorded source retrieval and inspection remain historical observations; edition preparation makes no fresh scholarly retrieval, PDF rehash, source inspection or literature-search claim. A failed Li PDF fetch and bounded author-page observations establish neither withdrawal nor invalidity.

QUEUE.md and unrelated entries remain unchanged. Editorial preparation adds no substantive proof turn and does not reset attempt 1/5. No merge, release, DOI or outside outreach is requested.
